body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 4 models with a format search (of 297 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 21.6 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 7.4 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae). 3 of 4 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (token agreement 100% → 44%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's), facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 64%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's) and stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (token agreement 100% → 97%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB), linear bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.7 dB), linear output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 35.5 dB), linear output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e3m4, 35.8 dB), groupnorm bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 35.8 dB), add output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e3m4, 36.2 dB), conv2d bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e3m4, 36.6 dB) and div output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 36.9 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): mul outputs end furthest from full precision, facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 keeping only -0.8 dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, -0.8 dB), conv2d in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 7.4 dB), linear in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 7.6 dB), attention in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), linear in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), silu in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 9.4 dB), groupnorm in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 9.6 dB), silu in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 10.5 dB), exp in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 11.0 dB) and attention in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 11.1 dB).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 2365 (61%), fp8_e3m4 868 (22%), fp8_e1m6 657 (17%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where a tensor's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: linear bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 40.4 dB), mul output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 38.6 dB) and linear bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 42.0 dB).

1 missing capability keep 29 operations in 1 model (of 3 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (29 operations in 1 model). In two sections, each ranked by the MACs its gaps hold:

### Substitute proposed or evaluated (0 gaps)

None.

### Found by the plan, not yet tried (1 gap)

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding) needs a workaround. It affects 29 operations in 1 model: 29 calls (1.48% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256. Cost today: 0 of 29 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 29 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

title: Missing instructions: 29 operations in 1 model need workarounds

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 357 of 517 tensors passed between kernels (69%) in 3 models: 207 for attention heads split or merged, 131 for other reshapes, 16 for pixels reordered and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 219 operations (219 calls, 11% of all calls; 73.9 G MACs, 14% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 207, linear → mul (other reshapes) 56 and linear → add (other reshapes) 56; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (196), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (128) and mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (33).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 357 of 517 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations with no built-in function at the store (GELU, SiLU, tanh, …) go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 264 operations in 3 models (264 calls, 13% of all calls), most often silu (160), sin (30) and cos (30). Their quantized accuracy: worst 10.5 dB SQNR over 264 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 49, most 58 (facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, 58 planned groups), over 3 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 34.4 powers of ten for mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (largest value 1.48e+04).

Instruction memory (IMEM, 1,024 words per bank) use: not measured yet (no kernel built).
title: Resource limits: 264 operations limited by the LUT and up to 58 kernel launches per pass

body: The largest measured cost is layout conversion: 324 of 475 inter-kernel tensors (68%) must be rearranged by the reading kernel — mostly attention head splits/merges after linear — affecting 204 calls (12%) and 73.7 G MACs (14%), though cycles are not yet measured. Next is accuracy loss under NX8 formats: with only 4 of 298 models format-searched, the worst tensor is DiT-XL-2-256's layernorm output at 32.1 dB SQNR, model outputs keep a median 21.6 dB (worst 7.4 dB in SD-v1.5's VAE), three models lose token agreement (worst 100%→44%), and mul outputs accumulate the most path error (−0.8 dB in DiT). Resource limits follow: 230 operations (13% of calls) run through a precision-limiting 256-entry LUT (worst 11.6 dB SQNR, mostly silu/sin/cos), with up to 58 kernel launches per pass. Missing run-time addressing blocks 29 embedding calls in 1 model (1.64% of calls, no MACs) from running directly, with no workarounds yet tried. Compute efficiency (MAC utilisation) and IMEM usage remain unmeasured since no kernel has been built or run.
